method: Source reconciliation; see validation.json for actual executions and limitations.

findings.claim: Secret-scanner fixture blocks CI
findings.current: Historical allowlist remediation remains. Scanner self-test passes all 11 rules. Current full invocation exits 0, reporting 1,557 available history blobs, 37 untracked-not-ignored files, 5,251 unavailable Git objects and 3 files over 1 MiB skipped. This is a bounded local result, not a clean complete-history or current CI claim.

findings.claim: seed.js deletes all custom sub-services on every deploy
findings.current: Seed now inserts with WHERE NOT EXISTS and preserves existing catalog entries. Regression spec exists; live deployment not tested.

findings.claim: Completion cancel dialog continues anyway
findings.current: Guard uses || and returns when cancelled/unmounted.
findings.verification: Static source trace only; no live/device verification.

findings.claim: Review :id/moderation route shadows photos/:photoId/moderation
findings.current: Specific photo route is now first. Original collision explanation is also incorrect: the patterns have different path-segment counts and cannot match the same URL in standard Express routing. Keep reorder as implemented, remove claim that endpoint was proven unreachable.

findings.claim: Trust route lacks role checks; inventory extends claim to bookings/providers.
findings.current: Trust rejects non-trust roles; bookings/providers also gate roles. Backend still enforces access. Old test.fixme assertion is active now, but stale explanatory comment remains.

findings.claim: Auditor support navigation and service mutation forms conflict with backend permissions.
findings.current: Support nav/page excludes auditor; services checks canMutateServices to hide mutation UI. Unconditional header notifications still links support for every role; this is a distinct residual UX issue.

findings.claim: Guarantee dropdown allows illegal transitions, leading to backend 409 crash.
findings.current: UI transition table and terminal rendering now exist. Claimed backend invalid-transition 409 is unsupported: updateStatus assigns any valid DTO enum without lifecycle validation. Thus UI gap fixed, backend invariant remains absent.

findings.claim: Orphan phone migration remains outside configured glob
findings.current: Named orphan file no longer exists. Configured migration glob remains backend/migrations. Absence checked against filesystem.

findings.claim: Two migrations share timestamp 1786521300000
findings.current: Both classes/files remain. Ordering ambiguity is maintenance risk; no demonstrated dependency/fresh-schema failure. Do not re-key already-applied migrations casually.

findings.claim: User deletion cascades authentication audit rows
findings.current: Later Phase2 migration replaces FK with ON DELETE SET NULL and permits null user_id. Whether deployment ran it is unverified; historical RestoreBookingIntegrity still has CASCADE but is superseded in source.

findings.claim: Complaint transitions unenforced in SQL
findings.current: Phase2 migration defines complaint transition function and BEFORE UPDATE OF status trigger consistent with current shared transition table. Database installation/behavior unverified.

findings.claim: Chat client_message_id has no unique constraint
findings.current: Partial unique index now exists in entity and Phase2 migration. Original missing-index defect addressed in source. Service retains lookup-then-save pattern without demonstrated unique-violation replay recovery, so concurrent retries may fail instead of return existing message; live behavior unverified.

findings.claim: Dead public mock inbox controller ships in source
findings.current: backend/src/notifications/inbox.controller.ts no longer exists. Active domain controller remains; deletion verified by filesystem. Original stub was unmounted, not an exposed production endpoint.

findings.claim: Complaint status body is inline type bypassing ValidationPipe
findings.current: Controller uses decorated UpdateComplaintStatusDto with IsEnum and bounded optional notes.

findings.claim: Recurring, guarantee, moderation tables lack FKs; evidence_urls simple-array corrupts commas
findings.current: Phase2 adds recurring customer, guarantee booking and moderation photo FKs; evidence_urls is jsonb in entity and migration. Additional soft UUID associations remain (recurring service_category_id, guarantee customer/provider/re-service references, moderation actor). Historical comma-corrupted data cannot be reconstructed by string_to_array migration.

findings.claim: Schema probes all skip on empty DB
findings.current: Orphan-booking FK probe runs before empty-seed branch. Negative amount, coordinate and job-proof probes still skip when users/categories absent. Report path scripts/verify-schema.ts is wrong; actual file is backend/scripts/verify-schema.ts. Script performs writes/deletes, so not run in read-only reconciliation.

findings.claim: Complaint dossier renders blank name/email due to UserDetail contract mismatch.
findings.current: Canonical user fields are optional, operations getUser reexports users implementation, and dossier renders explicit user-ID / identity-redacted fallbacks. Backend still intentionally projects minimal PII; unavailable personal fields are not by themselves defects.

findings.current: Dispatch handlers now have dedicated tests for registrations, fanout, project and expiry. No exact admin-operations.service.spec.ts or resource-ownership.spec.ts found; other authorization tests provide indirect coverage and do not prove none.

findings.claim: All seventeen shared contracts lack tests; state machines untested

No colocated shared specs, but zero-tests blanket claim false. Other compile-time type-only files do not inherently need runtime tests.

findings.claim: 12/18 routes have zero automated coverage.
findings.current: Numerical absolute claim stale/unsupported: dashboard/login/bookings/users/unauthorized have E2E route coverage; guarantee detail has lifecycle unit tests; trust role regression test exists. Several dossier/CRUD/routes still lack dedicated behavior coverage. Unit-helper coverage is not full rendered-page or persistence coverage. Parent runs current admin tests; no tests rerun by this subagent. Historical inventory cites management-api.test.ts and features/search/search.test.ts, neither exists in current admin/src; do not treat those as present tests.

Historical browser-unavailability diagnosis is not a current runtime result.

findings.claim: 89 verified distinct gaps, 82% integrity, 36 PASS / 5 WARN / 4 FAIL, and feature completion percentages are established measurements.
findings.current: The gaps register references 74 distinct GAP IDs; the nine reports together reference 79. Ten IDs in 1–89 are absent. The 45-row integrity matrix actually has 34 PASS / 6 WARN / 5 FAIL. No scoring formula or reproducible feature-status denominator supports 82% or the summary percentages. Historical reported test counts are not current execution evidence. Source facts here use HIGH confidence; no live DB/device/HTTP persistence verification is claimed.

findings.claim: SOS waves at 60/120 seconds radii 3/6/12km with 300-second hotline fallback
findings.current: Current approved constant table uses wave 2 after 3 minutes, wave 3 after 8 minutes, wave2 radius multiplier 2, max wave 3, daily cap 3 and cooldown 30 minutes. Fallback guidance is local emergency services, not a proven dedicated hotline. Audit workflow table must not substitute invented schedule.

findings.claim: Database inventory describes Gemini vision, standalone speech adapter, redis-cache.service and mail.service as installed implementations
findings.current: Named paths do not exist. Actual AI adapter is ai/providers/huggingface-ai.provider.ts; SMTP is notifications/otp-delivery.ts; Redis is cache/cache.module.ts and realtime publisher. FCM is push-delivery.ts; Razorpay is payment-gateway.ts. Do not report nonexistent integrations as deployed/operational.

findings.claim: Generic S3/AWS variables, presigned URLs, Redis graceful fallback, Postgres pool/TLS options are verified inventory

Redis production failures remove readiness/fail boot, not blanket EventEmitter degradation. Database module does not explicitly set claimed pool/SSL options. Adapter defaults/retries/security promises must be re-evidenced individually; environment state not read.

No referenced core/location/geocoding_service.dart exists. OSM widgets set userAgentPackageName to com.fixnow.app; no missing-User-Agent defect established. External terms/rate limits not verified.

findings.claim: Inventory promises metrics IP allowlist and SMTP_PASSWORD/MAIL_FROM with audit persistence and timeout
findings.current: MetricsController is explicitly public with aggregate non-PII content, no controller IP allowlist. SMTP uses SMTP_PASS/SMTP_FROM in otp-delivery.ts; the adapter sends plain text, and its code does not set the reported 30-second timeout or audit-table write. Inventory must represent actual controls.
